# LynxOPC

> LynxOPC is a ledger of One-Person Company (OPC) policies and communities in China.
> All data is sourced from government public policy documents, official park announcements, and news reports — never AI-fabricated.

## About

LynxOPC aggregates publicly available OPC (一人公司) rent-free, subsidy, and incubation policies across Chinese cities. Currently focused on Hangzhou, especially Yuhang District.

## What you'll find

- Policy entries with benefit summaries, requirements, and official source links
- Community/incubator profiles with contact info
- City comparison tool
- Open data: JSON API, RSS, llms.txt

## Data

- JSON API: https://opc.lynxflow.co/data/opc.json
- RSS: https://opc.lynxflow.co/rss.xml

## Pages

- / — Home with city overview and policy/community cards
- /cities/hangzhou.html — Hangzhou detail (Yuhang focus)
- /compare.html — City comparison tool

## Coverage

Currently: Hangzhou (6 policies, 4 communities)
Planned: Expand to more cities with verified public sources.

## Source Principle

Every policy entry links to its government/park/news source. Missing official links are labeled as reference sources, never fabricated.
